From d281a28bd2a94d72c440457e05a2f04a52f15947 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Adam Guerin <adam.guerin@intel.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2024 13:24:03 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] crypto: qat - improve error logging to be consistent across
 features

Improve error logging in rate limiting feature. Staying consistent with
the error logging found in the telemetry feature.

Fixes: d9fb8408376e ("crypto: qat - add rate limiting feature to qat_4xxx")
Signed-off-by: Adam Guerin <adam.guerin@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Giovanni Cabiddu <giovanni.cabiddu@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/crypto/intel/qat/qat_common/adf_rl.c b/drivers/crypto/intel/qat/qat_common/adf_rl.c
index 65f752f4792a..346ef8bee99d 100644
--- a/drivers/crypto/intel/qat/qat_common/adf_rl.c
+++ b/drivers/crypto/intel/qat/qat_common/adf_rl.c
@@ -1125,7 +1125,7 @@ int adf_rl_start(struct adf_accel_dev *accel_dev)
 	}
 
 	if ((fw_caps & RL_CAPABILITY_MASK) != RL_CAPABILITY_VALUE) {
-		dev_info(&GET_DEV(accel_dev), "not supported\n");
+		dev_info(&GET_DEV(accel_dev), "feature not supported by FW\n");
 		ret = -EOPNOTSUPP;
 		goto ret_free;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/crypto/intel/qat/qat_common/adf_rl.c`**
   - The error logging message in the `adf_rl_start` function was modified. 
   - The original message `not supported\n` was changed to `feature not supported by FW\n`. This change enhances clarity by specifying that the feature is not supported by the firmware (FW).

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `adf_rl.c` is aimed at improving the consistency of error logging across different features within the QAT (QuickAssist Technology) driver. Specifically, it aligns the error message format in the rate limiting feature with that of the telemetry feature, thereby enhancing the overall readability and maintainability of the code. This change is part of a broader effort to standardize error logging practices within the driver.

```c
dev_info(&GET_DEV(accel_dev), "not supported\n");
```
Reason:
The original error logging message was vague, simply stating "not supported" without specifying that the feature was unsupported due to firmware limitations. This lack of clarity could lead to confusion during debugging and hinder developers' ability to quickly identify the root cause of the issue.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
dev_info(&GET_DEV(accel_dev), "feature not supported by FW\n");
```
Reason:
The patch improves the error logging by providing a more descriptive message that clearly indicates the reason for the unsupported feature, specifically attributing it to firmware limitations. This consistency in error messages across different features enhances the clarity of error handling and debugging processes.
